svg.title: The specimen trained from 48 seeds: Adam at a constant rate keeps leaving the floor; as a cosine schedule shrinks the rate, the flights stop.
svg.desc: Loss (logarithmic, 0.05 to 2.2 nats) against step (linear, 0 to 2000). Ink: Adam (β₂ 0.95, no weight decay, no clipping) at constant η = 0.02. Value ink: the same with 20 warmup steps and cosine decay to 0.002. Fresh draws of θ₀ from the book's initial distributions, JS seeds 1–48. After step 300 the constant-rate runs make 290 jumps in which the loss more than doubles in one step, the last at step 1999; the scheduled runs make 72, the last at step 1043, when η has fallen to 1.1e-2.
